# Forage Denmark

> A free guide to wild food in Denmark: which wild plants are in season in each region and month, how to recognise and harvest them, the dangerous lookalikes to avoid, and 32 dishes to cook with them.

Seasons and ranges are approximate. Every plant should be confirmed with an experienced local forager before eating.

- [App](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/): pick a region and month to see what is wild near you
- [All wild plants](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/)
- [All dishes](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/)

## Wild plants

- [Stinging nettle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/nettle/): Urtica dioica; Brændenælde. In season March to June.
- [Wild garlic](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/wildgarlic/): Allium ursinum; Ramsløg. In season March to May.
- [Dandelion](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/dandelion/): Taraxacum officinale; Mælkebøtte. In season March to October.

- [Juneberry](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/serviceberry/): Amelanchier lamarckii; Bærmispel. In season June to July.
- [Gutweed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/gutweed/): Ulva intestinalis; Tarmrørhinde. In season March to October.
- [Bladderwrack](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/bladderwrack/): Fucus vesiculosus; Blæretang. In season March to September.
- [Cockles](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/cockleeu/): Cerastoderma edule; Hjertemusling. In season September to April.
- [Razor clams](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/razorclam/): Ensis spp.; Knivmusling. In season October to April.
- [Oysters](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/oyster/): Ostrea edulis / Magallana gigas; Østers. In season September to April.
- [Oyster mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/oystermush/): Pleurotus ostreatus; Østershat. In season October to March.
- [Horn of plenty](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/blacktrumpet/): Craterellus cornucopioides; Trompetsvamp. In season August to November.
- [Shaggy inkcap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/shaggymane/): Coprinus comatus; Stor parykhat. In season May to November.
- [St George's mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/stgeorge/): Calocybe gambosa; Vårmusseron. In season April to June.
- [Jelly ear](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/jellyear/): Auricularia auricula-judae; Judasøre. In season all year round.
- [Saffron milk cap](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/saffronmilkcap/): Lactarius deliciosus / L. deterrimus; Velsmagende mælkehat. In season August to October.
- [Wood blewit](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/blewit/): Lepista nuda; Violet hekseringshat. In season October to December.
- [Morel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/morel/): Morchella spp.; Morkel. In season March to May.
- [Field mushroom](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/fieldmushroom/): Agaricus campestris; Mark-champignon. In season August to October.
- [Cauliflower fungus](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/cauliflowerfungus/): Sparassis crispa; Kruset blomkålssvamp. In season August to November.
- [Pineapple weed](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/pineappleweed/): Matricaria discoidea; Skive-kamille. In season June to September.
- [White clover](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/whiteclover/): Trifolium repens; Hvidkløver. In season May to September.
- [Rosebay willowherb](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/plants/fireweed/): Chamerion angustifolium; Gederams. In season April to August.

## Dishes

- [Elderflower cordial (hyldeblomstsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderflower-cordial/): Flowers steeped with lemon and citric acid, sweetened and bottled. A Danish summer staple.
- [Sea buckthorn juice (havtornsaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-buckthorn-juice/): Sour orange berries juiced and sweetened, rich in vitamin C.
- [Sloe schnapps (slåensnaps)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sloe-schnapps/): Frosted sloes steeped in neutral spirit with a little sugar until Christmas.
- [Woodruff schnapps (skovmærkesnaps)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/woodruff-schnapps/): Wilted woodruff steeped briefly in aquavit.
- [Mussels in white wine (muslinger)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/mussels-in-white-wine/): Limfjord mussels steamed with wine, shallots and parsley.
- [Fried samphire (kveller)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/fried-samphire/): Samphire tossed in butter as a salty side for fish.
- [Wild garlic pesto (ramsløgspesto)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/wild-garlic-pesto/): Ramsons blended with oil, nuts and cheese.
- [Rose hip jam (hybenmarmelade)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/rose-hip-jam/): Seeded hips cooked into a tart orange jam.
- [Rowan jelly (rønnebærgelé)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/rowan-jelly/): Rowan with apple, set into jelly for game and roast pork.
- [Pickled elderflower capers](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/pickled-elderflower-capers/): Green elderberries pickled like capers.
- [Nettle soup (brændenældesuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/nettle-soup/): Young nettles in a green soup with egg.
- [Sea beet with butter and fish](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-beet-with-butter-and-fish/): Wilted sea beet with butter and lemon alongside fried plaice.
- [Hazelnut bread (hasselnødbrød)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/hazelnut-bread/): Rye bread studded with toasted hazelnuts.
- [Elderberry soup (hyldebærsuppe)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderberry-soup/): Hot elderberry soup with apple and small dumplings.
- [Elderflower buttermilk (koldskål)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderflower-buttermilk/): Chilled buttermilk sweetened with elderflower, with kammerjunker biscuits.
- [Blackberry crumble](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/blackberry-crumble/): Blackberries under a buttery oat crumble.
- [Raspberry and gooseberry trifle](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/raspberry-and-gooseberry-trifle/): Summer berries layered with cream and macaroons.
- [Rugosa rose hip syrup](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/rugosa-rose-hip-syrup/): Hyben from the beach rose cooked into a deep red syrup.
- [Birch sap (birkesaft)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/birch-sap/): Fresh spring sap, chilled.
- [Sea rocket and beach greens salad](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-rocket-and-beach-greens-salad/): Peppery beach greens with apple and buttermilk dressing.
- [Chanterelles on rye (kantareller på rugbrød)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/chanterelles-on-rye/): Butter-fried chanterelles on rye bread with herbs.
- [Pickled rosehips](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/pickled-rosehips/): Seeded hips pickled sweet-sour for pork.
- [Mirabelle jam](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/mirabelle-jam/): Wild cherry plums cooked into a golden jam.
- [Porcini risotto (karljohan)](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/porcini-risotto/): Creamy risotto with fried porcini.
- [Puffball schnitzel](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/puffball-schnitzel/): Breaded slices of young giant puffball, fried.
- [Elderflower cake](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/elderflower-cake/): Sponge soaked in elderflower syrup.
- [Sea buckthorn sorbet](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/sea-buckthorn-sorbet/): Tart orange sorbet of sea buckthorn juice.
- [Fried morels on rye](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/fried-morels-on-rye/): Morels fried in butter on rye bread.
- [Steamed oysters from the Limfjord](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/steamed-oysters-from-the-limfjord/): Limfjord oysters, raw or steamed.
- [Saffron milk caps with eggs](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/saffron-milk-caps-with-eggs/): Fried milk caps with scrambled eggs.
- [Pickled sea aster](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/pickled-sea-aster/): Strandasters in sweet vinegar.
- [Damson compote](https://eaten676.github.io/foragetheworld/dk/dishes/damson-compote/): Krægekompot with cream.
